description: Fast, low-cost check of ONE factual claim. Returns verdict supported, contradicted or unsure, a confidence score, a short reason and 1-2 public sources (Wikipedia, plus Wikidata structured facts where they apply) with quote and URL. Synchronous. Cheaper and faster than deep_verify; use it on the claims extract_claims returns (its next_step gives the exact body). Unsure or low-confidence results include a next_step to deep_verify. Price: $0.15 USDC on Base per call via x402; this MCP call returns payment instructions and POST /v1/quick_check returns the verdict. Read-only.

claim.description: The single factual claim to check.

text.description: One atomic factual claim, up to 1000 characters, for example a claim text returned by extract_claims.

name: quick_check

payment.description: Payment instructions. MCP tools/call does not charge or run the paid work; call the HTTP route with x402.

amount.description: Price in USDC base units (6 decimals).

body.description: JSON body to POST (the tool arguments you sent).

method.description: HTTP method for the paid route.

price.description: Price in USD, paid as USDC.

result.description: Paid result: { mode: 'quick', verdict: supported|contradicted|unsure, verdict_detail, confidence, claim, reason, sources: [{ url, title, quote, source_type }] (max 2), next_step|null, receipt }.

anyOf.description: Present only on unsure or low-confidence claims (check_answer) or unverified high/medium-worthiness factual claims (extract_claims; opinions and predictions skipped; max 3 per response). A ready-to-send request for this claim (optional, paid separately): Quick check ($0.15) from extract_claims, Deep verify from check_answer and quick_check. extract_claims adds alternatives[] with ready-to-send Quick check ($0.15), Deep verify ($0.75) and Verify claim ($1.00) requests.

alternatives.description: 1.4.9 (extract_claims): every ready-to-send paid check for this claim. POST body to endpoint with an x402 client.

tool.description: 1.5.0: quick_check from extract_claims; deep_verify from check_answer and quick_check.

verdict.description: Three-way verdict. contradicted includes outdated; unsure covers mixed and insufficient_evidence.

verdict_detail.description: Full verdict: supported, contradicted, outdated, mixed or insufficient_evidence.

status.description: payment_required: pay the HTTP route with x402 to get the result. ok: result is included.
